title: Most People Miss This About Jealousy Between Sisters
paragraphs: Most People Miss This About Jealousy Between Sisters
That’s the part nobody says out loud.

The smile was real… but tight.
The hug was warm… but heavy.
Because deep inside, comparison was whispering louder than love.
It doesn’t always look like anger.

Sometimes it looks like silence.
Distance.
Subtle competition.

One was loved.
One was overlooked.

Leah longed to be chosen.
Rachel burned to be fruitful.

Both were blessed…
But neither felt enough.

Jealousy blinds you to your portion
because you’re staring at someone else’s.

Leah carried legacy.
Rachel carried desire.
Both were seen.

The enemy loves sister-against-sister battles—
because divided hearts can’t reflect whole love.

At the cross,
your worth stopped being measured against someone else.

In blood.
In grace.
In full acceptance.

So when jealousy rises—
don’t hide it.

Because healing starts
where honesty meets the Savior.
